text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After successfully running through the 
Twinkle Series together with Aston 
Machan... one day, some time had passed.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
This week, we have three special guests 
who truly represent this year's 
generation~!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to it! Let's do this! I'm 
looking forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
—Yes! Thank you very much! Please move 
over to those seats over there.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
Next question! Do the three of you have 
any memorable moments together?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
For me, it's the Oka Sho. Right after 
losing to Vodka in the Tulip Sho, I was 
super fired up.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
On top of that, Chan declared war on me, 
so I went in with the mindset that I was 
definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"For me, out of the three of them, it was 
when Machan said she was giving up on the 
Tiara path!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
She made a clean break with zero lingering 
regrets— I thought that was super cool!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan has plenty too, you know. But if 
you're asking for number one..."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: We all made an independent movie together.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
And so! Aston Machan has actually prepared 
some footage from back then for us!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the frozen Daiwa Scarlet and Vodka 
aside, footage from back then began to 
play in the studio.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha~!!" "Hold it right there, Ace Spy 
Chan! Today is the day you won't get 
away!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Back in the beginning. It's a masterpiece 
born from everyone joining forces!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-Is this really going to be 
broadcast...?!

text_block_list.name: Show Director
text_block_list.text:
We can replace the cuts after recording, 
so please let us know if anything feels 
too difficult.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm sorry...! But I can't possibly 
trouble you with that--

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
No, I can't after all! I really, really 
don't want to!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly very sorry, but let's ask to 
have it replaced with something else!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Still, both of you looked like you were 
really getting into it on camera.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It was fine back then! But now?! I can't 
stand having anyone see such robotic 
acting!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The 'Scarlet Queen' really lost all her 
dignity, huh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You were totally speaking in a monotone 
too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you just need some kind of footage, 
let's look for something else! I can even 
pick it out for you if you want, okay?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, in that case, I'll search for it! I 
can't leave this to you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No. You're only going to bring out things 
that try to look cool anyway.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like you're one to talk— you only ever 
pick stuff that's totally straight-laced!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then that one really is the best choice. 
Not too cool, not too serious—just 
perfectly lovely.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Anything but that! Not that, please...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. Then shall we settle this in a 
race?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"If you win the race, you're the greatest. 
No one can complain about that."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Sounds fun, I'll play along!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't come crying to me if you end up in 
tears!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Filming finished, and I arrived to pick up 
the three who were already packed up and 
ready.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet, no matter how long I waited, they 
didn't show. Instead, it was strangely 
noisy outside. Fearing the worst, I went 
to check—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the freestyle racing venue, three 
figures could be seen stretching...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
1,600m clockwise... Hmph, I cannot afford 
to lose this.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This is a once-in-a-lifetime showdown, 
with our videos on the line.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Who do you think will win, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vodka, Scarlet, and Machan.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, Chan-me! Get in the gate already!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, too bad. Make sure you tell me 
properly later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Mar-chan. ...Just letting 
you know, I always believed in you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――Soon, the race begins. Three shadows 
intertwine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Who is the strongest? Who is the fastest? 
It won't be long until we have our answer.
